name: Ray
source:
The rival mafia group's daughter. 

Ray looks like a calm and gentle girl at first glance. However, with a strong sense of determination she is able to face tough situations. She resists her father’s wishes for her to marry an official within her organization.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.mafiagirl]Google Play[/url]]
